# Public W56 stock Variant fixture

`compact/part` and `basic/part` are synthetic, public-data-free MergeTree parts
generated by `scripts/generate_public_wide_variant_w56_fixture.sh` with the pinned
ClickHouse local 26.7.1.1315 official build. Its schema is exactly
`pk UInt64, payload Variant(String, UInt64)`, its codec is LZ4, and its marks
are plain `.mrk2`.

The seven rows use keys 1 through 7 and payloads
`String("alpha"), UInt64(42), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, String("")`. With
`index_granularity = 3`, the mark row counts are `[3, 3, 1]`: the first mark
mixes alternatives and NULL, the second is all NULL, and the short final mark
contains an empty String. The fixture contains no customer or private data.

The compact profile uses
`use_compact_variant_discriminators_serialization = 1`; the basic profile sets
it to `0`. Regenerate either profile only after removing that target fixture
intentionally; the generator refuses to overwrite an existing fixture. Verify
their inventory, mark shape, LZ4 frames, and SHA-256 lists with
`bash scripts/verify_stock_wide_variant_w56_fixture.sh compact` and
`bash scripts/verify_stock_wide_variant_w56_fixture.sh basic`.
For an isolated repeatability check, set `W56_FIXTURE_ROOT` to a fresh
directory; the generator refuses to overwrite an existing profile.
